landing.how.title: How Hipo works
landing.how.subtitle: Stake any amount of GRAM and earn more than just staking rewards.
landing.how.step1.title: 1 · Stake GRAM
landing.how.step1.body: Deposit your GRAM into Hipo to earn the highest staking rewards in the market.
landing.how.step2.title: 2 · Get liquid hGRAM
landing.how.step2.body: Get hGRAM representing your staked GRAM. Its value grows as rewards accumulate, and it works across TON DeFi.
landing.how.step3.title: 3 · Earn free HPO
landing.how.step3.body: Stakers also earn HPO through Hipo Club — both come free with staking, nothing extra to pay.
landing.how.step4.title: 4 · Unstake anytime
landing.how.step4.body: Return your hGRAM whenever you want. You'll receive GRAM plus your accumulated staking rewards.
